ria: Quick postmortem follow-up. Pattern: overnight model-load spikes -> brief 503 windows (~2-4m). Need a tiny runbook + triage script. Two-week ship target.

ria: Draft action items (short):
1) Compact runbook with explicit escalation ladder (0/2/10m). owner: dan. due: 2024-12-08
2) `mini-triage.sh` (health, p50/p95 model_load, error rate, quick logs). owner: sol. due: 2024-12-08
3) Cron warmup job (23:50). owner: infra. due: 2024-12-10
4) Fallback route to standby model variant on failure. owner: ria. due: 2024-12-15

ria: Minimal triage snippet to include in script (no tokens hardcoded):
curl -fsS https://api.redwood-infer/health || echo "health: FAIL"
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=model_load_latency_p50" | jq .
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=model_load_latency_p95" | jq .
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=request_error_rate" | jq .
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --tail=200

sol: I'll take `mini-triage.sh`. script will read METRICS_KEY from env or prompt, add --quick and --full modes, and a --dry-run. won't hardcode secrets.

dan: I'll write the compact runbook: top-of-doc checklist only (detect -> confirm -> collect -> mitigate -> escalate). expanded appendix for SREs. will include exact `kubectl` snippets and safe-restart hint.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-420. Epic RINF-623. Tabletop set for 2024-12-06 16:00 UTC.

sol: question: For triage, p50/p95 + error rate good? or include p99?

dan: keep triage light: p50/p95 + error rate. p99 for postmortem only.

ria: Please link PRs to RINF-623. I'll gate playbook review until triage script + cronjob PRs are linked. After PRs land, we'll run tabletop with on-call. Keep playbook prescriptive and "do this first".

sol: will post first-pass gist tomorrow.

dan: will open runbook PR Monday.

ria: thanks team. :thumbsup:
